_comment: Round-trip truth table for engine-code shorthand (PRD-FBS-FIT-002 §9.3). The API's jest suite asserts that expandSlashToken(compressed) === codes; the web suite asserts that compressEngineCodes(codes) === compressed. The two implementations live in different packages (there is no shared package in this repo), so this shared fixture is what stops them drifting apart.
_notCompressible_comment: Cases that must render separately. Compression is cosmetic, so every guard fails safe.
